name: engineer-flow
description: Framework-agnostic engineering skill orchestrator with dynamic skill discovery, sparse routing, and memory infrastructure.
author: Syarif

install.genericPrompt: Read AGENTS.md, then use skills/engineer-flow/SKILL.md as the entrypoint. Discover project and installed skills before selecting specialists.

skills.name: engineer-flow
skills.description: Universal engineering task orchestrator that discovers installed skills, routes sparsely, runs memory preflight, and delegates to 0-2 specialists.

skills.name: memory-management
skills.description: Framework-agnostic project memory infrastructure for sparse recall and durable checkpointing without consuming specialist slots.

skills.name: minimal-change
skills.description: General engineering fallback for smallest safe changes, behavior preservation, narrow diffs, and avoiding overengineering.

skills.name: debugging
skills.description: General debugging fallback for reproducing failures, isolating root causes, and validating fixes.

skills.name: testing
skills.description: General testing fallback for selecting focused unit, integration, regression, smoke, and end-to-end checks.

skills.name: security
skills.description: General security fallback for authorization, input handling, secret safety, injection risks, and dependency exposure.

skills.name: architecture
skills.description: General architecture fallback for boundaries, dependency direction, modularity, interfaces, and data flow.

skills.name: database
skills.description: General database fallback for schema, queries, transactions, migrations, consistency, indexing, and persistence.

skills.name: performance
skills.description: General performance fallback for bottleneck analysis, caching, query efficiency, async work, and large datasets.

skills.name: api-integration
skills.description: General API and integration fallback for HTTP clients, retries, contracts, pagination, versioning, and webhooks.

skills.name: frontend-ui
skills.description: General frontend and UI fallback for component behavior, accessibility, responsive layout, state, and styling.

skills.name: infrastructure-devops
skills.description: General infrastructure and DevOps fallback for CI, deployment, environment config, queues, containers, and cloud services.

skills.name: data-processing
skills.description: General data processing fallback for ETL, batch jobs, streaming, validation, large files, and transformations.

skills.name: refactoring
skills.description: General code quality and refactoring fallback for simplifying complex code, reducing duplication, and preserving behavior.

skills.name: planning
skills.description: General planning and execution fallback for breaking down work, identifying risks, sequencing changes, and verification.

skills.name: documentation
skills.description: General documentation fallback for README updates, runbooks, design notes, release notes, API docs, and explanations.

skills.name: code-review
skills.description: General code review fallback for bug-risk analysis, regressions, missing tests, maintainability, and release readiness.

skills.name: dependency-tooling
skills.description: General dependency and tooling fallback for package managers, build tools, linters, formatters, and version upgrades.

skills.name: ai-llm-engineering
skills.description: General AI and LLM engineering fallback for prompts, agents, evals, routing, embeddings, model APIs, and tool calling.
